name: When is engineering coordination typically required for a home renovation?

mainEntity.name: When is engineering coordination typically required for a home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Engineering coordination is typically required for renovations involving structural modifications, significant layout changes, new additions, or updates to major mechanical, electrical, or plumbing systems. For example, adding a second story, removing load-bearing walls, or relocating a kitchen in a whole-home remodel will necessitate structural engineering input. AKN Design Group proactively identifies these requirements during the initial design phase, incorporating necessary engineering expertise to ensure a seamless and compliant project execution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Engineering coordination is needed for structural changes, significant layout modifications, new additions, or major system upgrades in a renovation.
